providers.description: Source implementation evidence for Vrooli symbols, functions, types, callers, packages, files, and architecture-owned file domains. Use this leaf for where concrete Go or application code is implemented, including router logic, policy behavior, persistence, and call paths; do not use it as the primary answer for proto declarations or generated service contracts. Results preserve analyzer, evidence status, source range, and query-time callers/references.

tests.name: Natural-language code question retrieval
tests.description: Reviewed natural-language code questions covering symbol locations, callers, package ownership, file inventory, and contract conformance. The intended p95 is 1500 ms; the phase-1 reading was 4172 ms and remains an explicit latency gap.

Locates generated service and contract declarations used by the implementation.

providers.description: Proto and service-contract evidence across Vrooli: RPC messages, service declarations, adoption, endpoint conformance, and generated client/server contract wiring. Use this leaf for which service owns a proto contract, whether a message or RPC is adopted, and how a contract reaches an API surface; do not use it as the primary answer for ordinary implementation functions, policy logic, or persistence code.
